description: X5.13: Quanser-style rotary double inverted pendulum on the spatial multibond stdlib. World -> Mount -> J1 (Revolute3D about world z, the arm) -> arm bar (RigidBody3D) -> J2 (Revolute3D about the arm axis, the lower link) -> J3 (upper link), every body a RigidBody3D with a distributed mass (COM at the bar middle). The arm is driven by an SRV02-like servo: Motor (ElectricDrive, voltage input) -> Shaft (ElasticShaft) -> Gear (IdealGear, 70:1) -> J1.drive. The 1 kHz firmware Ctrl (phases: idle, TVLQR swing-up along the collocation trajectory, latched LQR balance) reads the joint angles and rates. Dist is a force pulse on the tip of the upper link. Joint compliance kt = kr = 1e6 (N/m, N m/rad); every state is integral. The actilink-* models are the same rig on a Synapticon ACTILINK-JD10 actuator (dq motor, current and velocity loops, gear backlash and friction, AS5048 encoders, 1 kHz EtherCAT LQR) and its identification experiments; written by design/actilink_finish.py.
